# Alex Chelaru, private chef in Gran Canaria

> Private chef cooking in villas, homes and on yachts across Gran Canaria, Canary Islands. European technique, Asian flavour, Canarian ingredients. Five fixed menus published in full, plus custom menus. English and Spanish.

## Service
- Villa and home dinners, celebrations, barbecue over coals, late breakfast and brunch, yacht meals by arrangement, several nights of a stay.
- Areas: Maspalomas, Meloneras, Mogán, Puerto Rico, Playa del Inglés, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria and the villas between them.
- The chef shops, cooks in the guest's kitchen, serves and washes up. The fourteen EU allergens are listed on every menu card.
- Enquiries: the form at https://alexchelaru.com/#enquire, or WhatsApp +34 641 275 731.
